page.notes: Marginal Arabic note at left beside "gradus": "* أربع مراتب" (partly unclear; the mark "*" in the text refers to it). Two left-margin notes carry the mark "*": "Ebnol Athir." and "AlGazal." Their order matches the text but the text marks are not separately distinguishable on the scan. Arabic lines are copied from a low-resolution scan; their word order and some letters are uncertain, especially "تطهير السر" in the last text line and the Arabic placed at the line ends. Left-margin entries "AlGazal. & Ebnol Athir." sit beside the paragraph opening "Munditici". The scan is faint at the left edge; a small stain is at the far left.
